description: Machine-readable high-blast-radius paths for Flutter Agent OS. Read by scripts/blast-radius-check.sh, the pre-commit hook, @flutter-verify and @flutter-implementation. Framework defaults below; consumer repos extend the consumer_* arrays in their project copy at {FLUTTER_STANDARDS_ROOT}/PROTECTED_SURFACES.json.

notes.framework_paths: Changing these changes behaviour for every repo the framework is installed into.
notes.consumer_paths: Application entry points and cross-cutting wiring. A defect here affects every feature.
notes.consumer_patterns: Native build, manifest, signing, CI and migration surfaces. Failures here are release-blocking or data-destroying and are usually invisible in a Dart-only review.
notes.never_commit_patterns: Signing material and credentials. Presence in a diff is a blocker regardless of approval; some entries (google-services.json, firebase_options.dart) are project decisions and may be intentionally committed - if so, remove them from this list in the project copy and record why.
notes.migrations: Local-store migrations are protected because a defect destroys user data irreversibly on devices you do not control.
